caption:
Before you say anything today, read this

Allah tells us that a person does not utter a single word without a vigilant watcher with him, ready to record it. Every message, every comment, every reply is part of that.

Surah Qaaf 50:18

Pick one word you will hold back today, and one kind word you will say instead.

#speech #guardyourtongue #surahqaf #muslimhabits

Recitation: Ahmed Al-Ajmi
